name: Interactivity listeners allocated on first use

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Interactivity listeners allocated on first use

Mechanism: the 21 listener and drag-style lists of `Interactivity` were `Vec`s (24 bytes each, 504 in all) moved through every builder call of every div; make them `LazyVec`, a one-word list that allocates on the first push. Allowed: elements/div.rs. Forbidden: any change to when listeners are registered.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Alternate the previous binary and the new one (alt2.sh, 3 each) over div-cards, hover-grid, all-panels, animated-dots, tree-toggle, text-relabel. Pass: no scenario slower, div-heavy CPU down.

measurements.metric: geomean of six scenarios, CPU / draw p50

reportMarkdown:
## Interactivity listeners allocated on first use Finished

Passed: true. Interactivity shrinks from 1,368 to about 860 bytes, which is less memmove in every builder chain and drop; allocations are unchanged because an element with a listener still makes the one allocation, which an element without any never did. The 1,038 lib tests pass; clippy clean.

Attempt Count: 1.
